notes:
What's new in 0.1.64:
• Fixed: the automatic-install update setting wasn't actually auto-installing new releases while the app kept running (it only checked once, right after launch). It now rechecks periodically, so turning that setting on actually works.
• Fixed: the Admin > Upload page (adding a movie/TV file to your library) failing when reached through your away-from-home address - large pieces of the file were being sent as one oversized network message over that connection and stalling. Uploads now work the same whether you're home or away.
• Routine dependency updates (React updated to 19, and other library bumps across the project).
